source.text_snippet: The condition is caused by biallelic loss‐of‐function mutations in either the ABCG5 or ABCG8 genes, which encode sterolin‐1 and sterolin‐2, respectively—two ATP‐binding cassette (ABC) transporters that form a heterodimer responsible for sterol efflux in enterocytes and hepatocytes.
